description:
What proving a credential against its live service established — never the
input, only the outcome.

Read back as well as built. A surface that is not in this process asks setup to
prove a credential and is told what came of it, so the four outcomes are tagged
by name rather than distinguished by which field is present — the same reason an
answer carries the step it belongs to.

oneOf.description: Proven working, carrying the capability observed while proving it.

observed.description: The observed fact — what the service did, not that it merely answered.

oneOf.description: The service answered and refused: the credential is wrong for it.

detail.description: What the service said, in terms the operator can act on.

oneOf.description: Nothing usable answered, so nothing can be concluded about the credential.

It authenticated, but cannot do the job it is for — exhausted, limited, or
otherwise unable.

detail.description: What it can no longer do, and why where the service says.
